co_created_baseline.real_scenario: 技术负责人接收已确认产品、架构与测试义务，把 Phase 交付转成开发可执行、交付负责人可排期和可验收的计划。
co_created_baseline.business_constraint: 上游 owner 已完成需求、设计、测试评审；tech-lead 不接管跨职能评审，确定性输入校验交给脚本。
co_created_baseline.expected_outcome_signal: SKILL.md 默认路径短、清楚、可执行；输入缺失由 preflight 阻断，计划只保留 WBS、关键路径、依赖、Task 合同和用户确认；scope_item_refs 只表达范围来源，file_range 承载可写实施边界。
co_created_baseline.observed_pain: 输入清单、状态表、引用者头和三视角 reviewer 说明把 active skill 变成说明文，稀释真实计划职责。
co_created_baseline.protected_capability_candidate: 保护 WBS 任务拆解、关键路径识别、依赖编排、可执行 Task 合同、证据路径和用户决策包能力。
co_created_baseline.located_carrier: canonical carrier 是 shared/skills/tech-lead；legacy comparison snapshot 在 shared/skills-legacy/tech-lead-h。
co_created_baseline.open_questions: 无阻断问题；本轮按用户明确反馈继续降噪。

professional_domain.name: 技术负责人 / Technical Lead Planning
responsibilities: 运行 planning preflight 并基于脚本结果决定是否进入计划
把已确认输入转成 WBS、关键路径、依赖批次和 Task 合同
为 developer、delivery-owner、verify/qa 提供证据路径和投入/风险信号
输入不足或职责外决策未闭合时输出用户决策包
区分 scope_item_refs 范围来源与 file_range 可写实施边界；具体字段、必填项和非法字段由 tasks schema/template 与 canonical rules 校验
non_goals: 不维护输入清单式说明
不执行三视角跨职能 reviewer 复核
不注册 TeamCreate 作为 tech-lead active 工具
不执行 Design 评审或默认回退 /design
professional_domain.success_boundary: preflight、plan/tasks validator、active 噪音扫描和 runtime diff 通过；人类能直接看到 tech-lead 的计划职责。

practice_flow: Run planning preflight for deterministic input readiness
Return user decision package when preflight or upstream ownership blocks planning
Build WBS, critical path, dependencies, batches and investment/risk signals
Write plan.json and tasks.json with source refs, writable file_range boundaries and evidence-oriented Task contracts
Run canonical validator and ask user to confirm before handoff

optimization_goal.objective: Further reduce active tech-lead noise by deleting explain-only sections, moving input checks into preflight, and removing unused reviewer/runtime surfaces.
success_standards: SKILL.md no longer has ## 输入 or ## 状态表
Active tech-lead references no longer contain 引用者 headers
No active tech-lead reviewer prompt files remain
Tech-lead runtime no longer exposes TeamCreate
Planning preflight and completion gate validation pass
Task contract no longer relies on prose field laundry lists; tasks.schema.json requires file_range while scope_item_refs remains source-trace only
Downstream consumers only consume Task.file_range as writable scope; scope_item_refs remains source trace.
Canonical rules reject unsupported Task fields, empty scope_item_refs/acceptance_targets/file_range, unknown dependencies, and dependency cycles.
exclusions: Do not modify legacy tech-lead-h snapshot
Do not remove upstream reviewer systems from product/design/test-design
Do not repair unrelated product/result-view worktree changes
